```lean
intro x
have h1 : 0 < √x := by simp [hx]
have h2 : Real.log √x > 0 := by simp [h1, log_pos]
let lx := Real.log √x
let l4 := Real.log 4
let term := l4 * x / lx + √x
have h3 : lx = (Real.log x) / 2 := by simp [Real.log_root_2]
have h4 : l4 * x / lx = 2 * l4 * x / (Real.log x) := by simp [h3]
have h5 : 2 * l4 * x / (Real.log x) = 2 * (Real.log 4) * x / (Real.log x) := rfl
have h6 : Real.log x = Real.log (x) := rfl
have h7 : 2 * (Real.log 4) * x / (Real.log x) = 2 * (Real.log 4) * x / (Real.log x) := rfl
have h8 : Real.log x > 0 := by simp [hx, log_pos]
have h9 : 2 * (Real.log 4) * x / (Real.log x) ≤ √x + √x :=
  by {
    rw [h7],
    apply le_add_right,
    apply le_rfl,
  }
apply le_trans h9
```
